context.description: Decision context the rules read (amount, jurisdiction, …). `units_by_metric` declares what the action would consume, keyed by quota metric_name, for the PDP's consumption stage.

purpose_class_id.description: Purpose class the action is claimed under. Checked by the PDP's purpose stage against the purpose classes the tenant's active policy set declares; a class the policy set does not declare is refused (purpose_class_not_found).

authority_grant_id.description: The mandate this action is taken under, so the PDP's consumption stage can find the quota grants bounding it.

policy_set_id.description: Pin the decision to one of the tenant's policy sets. Absent: the tenant's most recently created, unrevoked policy set.

request_id.description: Caller correlation id. Recorded on the evidence; it is NOT part of decision identity, so two identical questions share one decision_id.
